prompts.prompt: What is the maximum PHY data rate for Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be), and what is the widest channel width it supports? Answer concisely with both numbers.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/wireless/SKILL.md - Wi-Fi Standards Overview: 802.11be / Wi-Fi 7, Max PHY Rate 46 Gbps, 320 MHz channels

prompts.prompt: In enterprise Wi-Fi site surveys, what target RSSI values in dBm are typically used for voice and video coverage versus general data coverage? Answer concisely with both numbers.
prompts.source: plugins/networking/skills/wireless/SKILL.md - Survey Best Practices: target RSSI -67 dBm for voice/video, -72 dBm for data
